title: Using Your HSA/FSA for Fertility Treatments & Devices
summary: Learn which fertility treatments, tests, and monitors are HSA/FSA eligible and how to easily buy approved products using your benefits funds online today.
body_markdown:
If you're exploring fertility care, you already know how quickly costs can add up. The good news is that many fertility treatments, tests, and monitoring tools may be eligible expenses under your[Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)](https://www.withflex.com/blog/what-are-hsas-fsas) , which means you can use pre-tax dollars to pay for fertility care.


In this guide, you'll learn exactly what qualifies, when you might need documentation like a[Letter of Medical Necessity (LMN)](https://www.withflex.com/blog/what-is-a-letter-of-medical-necessity) , and how to easily shop for eligible fertility products online as we cover:


- [Is fertility treatment HSA and FSA eligible?](https://www.withflex.com/blog/hsa-fsa-eligible-fertility#is-fertility-treatment-hsa-and-fsa-eligible)
- [Types of medical conditions that qualify fertility products and treatment as HSA/FSA eligible](https://www.withflex.com/blog/hsa-fsa-eligible-fertility#types-of-medical-conditions-that-qualify-fertility-products-and-treatment-as-hsafsa-eligible)
- [How to buy fertility treatment, tests, and monitors using your HSA or FSA directly or through reimbursement](https://www.withflex.com/blog/hsa-fsa-eligible-fertility#how-to-buy-fertility-treatment-tests-and-monitors-using-your-hsa-or-fsa-directly-or-through-reimbursement)
- [13 HSA & FSA approved fertility products & treatments you can pay for using your plan directly](https://www.withflex.com/blog/hsa-fsa-eligible-fertility#13-hsa--fsa-approved-fertility-products--treatments-you-can-pay-for-using-your-plan-directly)
- [3 FAQs about using your HSA or FSA for fertility expenses](https://www.withflex.com/blog/hsa-fsa-eligible-fertility#3-faqs-about-using-your-hsa-or-fsa-for-fertility-expenses)


Let's start with whether fertility treatment is eligible, and what types of care qualify.


## Is fertility treatment HSA and FSA eligible?


Fertility treatments are often[eligible under IRS guidelines](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p969) , but eligibility depends on the specific service, product, and your medical situation.


### Commonly covered HSA and FSA fertility expenses


Many fertility-related services and products qualify without much friction.


- Fertility diagnostic tests
- Ovulation predictor kits
- Pregnancy tests
- In vitro fertilization (IVF)
- Artificial insemination (IUI)
- Fertility medications
- Lab work and monitoring
- Sperm and egg storage
- Fertility monitors


### Do you always need an LMN for fertility treatment?


You don't always need an LMN. Doctor visits, prescriptions, diagnostic tests, and IVF/IUI are typically covered. You may need an LMN for tracking devices, monitors with advanced features, at-home fertility kits, and supplements.

## Types of medical conditions that qualify fertility products and treatment as HSA/FSA eligible


To qualify for HSA or FSA spending, fertility care must relate to a diagnosed medical condition.


- [Infertility](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/infertility/symptoms-causes/syc-20354317)
- [PCOS](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/pcos/symptoms-causes/syc-20353439)
- [Endometriosis](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/endometriosis/symptoms-causes/syc-20354656)
- Hormonal imbalances
- [Low sperm count](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/low-sperm-count/symptoms-causes/syc-20374585)
- Irregular menstrual cycles
- [Reproductive disorders](https://www.cdc.gov/reproductive-health/women-health/common-concerns.html)


Eligibility comes down to medical necessity.

You have two main options: paying directly or submitting a reimbursement claim.

## 3 FAQs about using your HSA or FSA for fertility expenses


### 1. Are fertility treatments automatically covered?


Not automatically, but many qualify if they meet IRS requirements tied to diagnosing or treating a medical condition.


### 2. Does travel for fertility treatments count?


Yes, travel related to qualified fertility treatment (mileage, lodging, parking) can qualify as long as it's primarily for medical care.


### 3. Can I use my HSA/FSA for surrogacy?


Most surrogacy costs are not eligible. Some specific medical expenses related to surrogacy may qualify with an LMN.


## In Summary


Your HSA or FSA gives you a powerful way to offset fertility costs using pre-tax dollars. The key is understanding medical necessity, documentation, and choosing the right products. The[Flex Marketplace](https://www.withflex.com/shop) makes it easy to shop for eligible products.
